items.name: WarpRoutine (practice mod)
items.signature: void warpToRoom(const CObjectId& worldId, const CObjectId& areaId)
items.role: Calls in order: (1) abort if mostRecentStateManager is null; (2) gpGameState->SetCurrentWorldId(worldId); (3) gpGameState->CurrentWorldState()->SetDesiredAreaAssetId(areaId); (4) CGameState::ContinueWithNewInitialState(mostRecentStateManager->GameState(), CGameState::SInitialState(areaId)); (5) mostRecentStateManager->GameInstanceState().QuitGame(NGameInstanceState::kQR_Warp). mostRecentStateManager is latched by the CPlayerMP1::ProcessInput hook (patches.cpp:60). Entry: drawAreaEntries menu click (WarpMenu.cpp:20).

src.evidence: void warpToRoom(const CObjectId& worldId, const CObjectId& areaId) {
